extension.summary: Record and schedule from Kodi's own Live TV
extension.description: Adds recording to the Live TV you already have. It finds your Vesper server and your IPTV providers on its own; press the menu button on a channel or a programme and choose Record with Vesper. Watch your recordings and resume where you stopped. Recordings are made and kept by your Vesper server.
extension.disclaimer: Vesper records only the sources you add yourself. Use it for content you have the right to record.
